name: Marxism–Leninism
description: Revolutionary branch of Marxism that advocates the seizure of power by a vanguard party and the dictatorship of the proletariat, with a planned economy and collectivization, serving as the foundation of the communist regimes of the 20th century.
phrase: I want a society ruled by a vanguard party, with the dictatorship of the proletariat and a planned, collectivized economy.
eli5: Lenin said a group of well-organised leaders, the party, should take power on behalf of the workers. Then the government owns the factories and farms and decides what gets made. There's only one party, and nobody is allowed to oppose it.

name: Stalinist Socialism
description: Soviet model consolidated by Stalin, marked by accelerated industrialization, agricultural collectivization, rigid central planning, personalized leadership and mass political repression.
phrase: I want a society under a strong leader and a single party, with agrarian collectivization, five-year plans and forced industrialization.
eli5: Stalin ruled the Soviet Union and wanted to build factories very fast. The government took over the farms, planned everything, and everyone had to worship the leader. People who disagreed were jailed or sent to labour camps, and millions died.

name: Maoist Communism
description: Mao's Chinese adaptation of Marxism, centered on the peasantry as the revolutionary force, protracted people's war, permanent mass mobilization, and cultural revolution against the party bureaucracy.
phrase: I want a society mobilized in protracted people's war led by the peasantry, with permanent cultural revolution against bureaucracy.
eli5: Mao brought communism to China by relying on farmers in the countryside, not just city workers. He believed the revolution should never stop. His plans changed China a lot; one of them, the Great Leap Forward, caused a famine in which tens of millions of people died.

name: Trotskyist Communism
description: Current of Trotsky, co-founder of the Soviet state and the Red Army, which defends permanent revolution, a vanguard party and the dictatorship of the proletariat, criticizing Stalinist bureaucracy without renouncing one-party rule.
phrase: I want permanent, worldwide revolution led by a vanguard party, with the dictatorship of the proletariat, a planned economy and no Stalinist bureaucracy.
eli5: Trotsky was one of the leaders of the Russian Revolution. He thought the revolution couldn't stay in just one country: it had to spread across the whole world. He fell out with Stalin, was thrown out, and was later murdered.

name: Luxemburgist Socialism
description: Democratic Marxism inspired by Rosa Luxemburg, which unites revolution and freedom, values the spontaneity of the masses and the general strike, and criticizes both reformism and the authoritarian centralism of vanguard parties.
phrase: I want a society moved by the spontaneity of the masses and the general strike, revolutionary and free, without authoritarian vanguards or reformism.
eli5: Rosa Luxemburg wanted workers to make a revolution, but without losing freedom. For her, everyone should be able to speak and disagree, even after the revolution, and the people should decide, not just the party.

name: National Communism
description: Current that combines a planned socialist economy with a strong national identity, prioritizing the sovereignty and interests of its own country over internationalism, often under personalist and centralized leadership.
phrase: I want a socialist society devoted to the sovereignty and interests of its own nation, under strong leadership, not internationalism.
eli5: It's communism, with the government planning the economy, but with a lot of pride in your own country. Instead of taking orders from another communist country, each nation does communism its own way.

name: Juche Socialism
description: North Korean doctrine formulated by Kim Il-sung that combines state socialism, national self-reliance, single-party rule, supreme leadership, militarization and rejection of external dependence, subordinating economy and society to the sovereignty of the regime.
phrase: I want a self-reliant, militarized society, guided by Juche under single-party rule and supreme leadership, with no dependence on the outside.
eli5: It's North Korea's idea. The country wants to do everything by itself, without needing anyone. One family has ruled for generations, everyone must worship the leaders, and almost nobody can leave the country or know what's happening outside.

name: Pol Pot Socialism
description: Radical agrarian communism of the Khmer Rouge that emptied cities, abolished money and markets, and pursued an egalitarian peasant society by force, causing one of the greatest genocides of the 20th century in Cambodia.
phrase: I want an egalitarian peasant society, without cities, money or markets, rebuilt by force under the revolutionary Angkar.
eli5: In Cambodia, Pol Pot and the Khmer Rouge forced everyone out of the cities to work in the fields. They got rid of money, schools and hospitals. In under four years, about a quarter of the population died.

name: Dengist Socialism
description: Pragmatic reform initiated by Deng Xiaoping that introduced markets, private property, and economic opening under the absolute control of the Communist Party, forming the model of socialism with Chinese characteristics.
phrase: I want pragmatic socialism, opening markets and private property to enrich the country, under the absolute control of the Communist Party.
eli5: Deng Xiaoping in China said: 'it doesn't matter if the cat is black or white, as long as it catches mice'. He let people open businesses and make money, but the Communist Party stayed in charge of everything.

name: State Socialism
description: System in which the state controls the means of production and directs the economy through central planning, promoting industrialization and welfare under strong political authority and limited popular democratic participation.
phrase: I want a society where the state controls the means of production and plans the economy, with strong political authority and little electoral debate.
eli5: The government owns the factories, farms and shops, and makes one big plan saying what everyone should produce. It's like the whole country is one big government company.

name: Authoritarian Progressivism
description: Project that imposes progressive social transformations from above, using state power to accelerate changes in customs and equality, even at the cost of individual liberties and organized political opposition.
phrase: I want a society transformed from the top down in customs and equality, using the state even against organized opposition.
eli5: A strong government that wants to change society very fast to make it more modern and equal, and doesn't let people choose whether they want it. It's forcing progress from the top down.

name: Eco-Authoritarianism
description: Current that advocates a strong, interventionist state to confront the environmental crisis, subordinating economic and political freedoms to ecological urgency and strict control of consumption and production.
phrase: I want a society where the state imposes strict limits on consumption and production to halt the ecological crisis, above individual freedoms.
eli5: The planet is in danger, so a very strong government orders everyone to stop polluting, even if people don't want to. Nature comes before freedom and money.

name: Left-Wing Technocracy
description: Model that combines socialist planning with scientific management of the economy, entrusting expert committees, rather than elections or party competition, with the rational organization of production and the egalitarian distribution of society's resources.
phrase: I want a society run by committees of experts, not elections, planning production and distributing resources with equality.
eli5: Experts and scientists plan the economy so everyone has what they need, using data and science instead of leaving everything to the market.

name: National Bolshevism (NazBol)
description: Syncretic ideology, also called NazBol, that fuses revolutionary socialism and radical nationalism, combining a collectivist economy, state authoritarianism, and rejection of liberalism, the West, and bourgeois individualism.
phrase: I want a society that fuses soviet and nation, collectivist and authoritarian, against liberalism, the West and bourgeois individualism.
eli5: Imagine mixing two groups that always fight: the kids who want to share every toy equally and the kids who think their country is the very best. National Bolshevism wants both at once: the government is the boss of everything, shares things out, and everyone has to love their country a lot.

name: Strasserist Socialism
description: Anti-capitalist wing of National Socialism, linked to Gregor Strasser, which emphasized a mass nationalist socialism, nationalization, and social revolution within the movement, later crushed by Hitler.
phrase: I want a nationalist mass social revolution within the movement, nationalizing the economy against capital and the old order.
eli5: It's like Nazism, but with a group that said: 'rich people and banks are bad guys too, let's give the factories to the nation'. They wanted a very nationalist country where the government takes over big companies. Hitler fell out with them and had one of their leaders killed.

name: Fascism
description: Ultranationalist doctrine of national rebirth that rejects liberalism and Marxism, exalts the totalitarian state and the leadership of a single chief, sees action and violence as a means of regeneration, and treats the nation as a secular religion, with variants beyond the Italian regime that gave it its name.
phrase: I want a nation exalted under a strong state and a single leader, with militarism, mass mobilization and corporations serving the fatherland.
eli5: Imagine a school where one principal is boss of everything, nobody may disagree, everyone wears the same uniform and marches together shouting that their school is the best in the world. Anyone who thinks differently gets punished. Fascism is that for a whole country: one leader, one nation, no opposition.

name: National Socialism
description: German variant of fascism based on racism, antisemitism, and expansionism, which united totalitarianism, the cult of Hitler, and the idea of a superior race, culminating in World War II and the Holocaust.
phrase: I want a society based on the Aryan race, politically hierarchical and authoritarian, with a strong, protectionist state capitalism.
eli5: This is Hitler's idea in Germany. He said some people were worth more than others because of where their family came from, and one single leader ruled everything. It led to the Second World War and the Holocaust, in which millions of people were murdered, most of them Jewish.

name: Falangism
description: Spanish authoritarian nationalism of Catholic and syndicalist inspiration, created by José Antonio Primo de Rivera on the corporatism of his father Miguel's dictatorship; it defends a corporatist state, national unity and social hierarchy, and was a pillar of Francoism.
phrase: I want a Catholic corporatist state, united under an authoritarian chief, with vertical unions organizing labor and protected trade.
eli5: It's a Spanish version of fascism with a lot of the Catholic Church mixed in. The idea is that Spain should be one big united family, with a strong government, important priests, and bosses and workers organised into groups the government controls instead of striking or fighting.

name: National Syndicalism
description: Nationalist and syndicalist current that rejects liberalism and Marxism, advocating national unity, corporatist organization of labor, authoritarian social justice, and popular mobilization around the state.
phrase: I want a nation mobilized around the state, with corporatist unions organizing labor and rejecting liberalism and Marxism.
eli5: Imagine every job becomes a team: the bakers' team, the miners' team, the teachers' team. Bosses and workers are on the same team, and the government coaches all of them. Nobody goes on strike, because everyone has to play together for the country.

name: Brazilian Integralism
description: Authoritarian nationalist movement that arose in 1930s Brazil, Christian and corporatist, with the motto God, Fatherland and Family, a mass aesthetic and opposition to liberalism and communism.
phrase: I want a homeland under God, Fatherland and Family, with a strong state and national leadership, opposed to liberalism and communism.
eli5: It was a movement in 1930s Brazil with the slogan 'God, Fatherland and Family'. Members wore green shirts, held parades, and wanted a strong Christian government with no squabbling parties. It was like European fascism, but with a Brazilian twist.

name: Authoritarian Capitalism
description: Model that combines a market economy and private property with a closed political regime, in which the state guarantees order, growth, and stability while restricting civil liberties and political competition.
phrase: I want a market economy with private property, under a closed state that guarantees order and growth by restricting political competition.
eli5: People can open shops, make money and buy what they like, but they can't choose the government or criticise it. It's like a busy market where everyone can sell freely, but the owner of the place is boss of everything and won't take complaints.

name: National Capitalism
description: System that unites free enterprise with strong protectionism and state direction, prioritizing industry, jobs, and national sovereignty over global free trade and unchecked foreign capital.
phrase: I want national industry protected by tariffs and state planning, with free enterprise serving the sovereignty and jobs of the country.
eli5: Businesses can exist and make money, but the country should buy what's made at home. The government puts taxes on foreign products to protect local factories and jobs. It's like saying: 'our own toys first, then the neighbours''.

name: Radical Right
description: Radical right movement born on the internet, combining identitarian nationalism, opposition to immigration and multiculturalism, criticism of globalism and provocative rhetoric. Part of its voices defend a nationalism based on race.
phrase: I want a nation with its own identity and controlled borders, one that questions multiculturalism and globalism, with freedom to speak without censorship.
eli5: It's a group that grew up on the internet, full of memes. They think their country is changing too fast because of immigrants and they don't like it. They want the country to stay 'the old way', and often make jokes that mock other groups.

name: Alt-Lite
description: Branch of the radical right that is nationalist and anti-globalist, emphasizing cultural identity, criticism of immigration and opposition to political correctness, without adopting race-based positions.
phrase: I want to preserve my people's cultural identity, with immigration controls and free speech against political correctness.
eli5: These people love their country a lot and don't like the whole world becoming the same, with the same rules and cultures. They make lots of jokes and criticism online, but don't go as far as the most radical groups.

name: Right-Wing Accelerationism
description: Current that defends accelerating the system's contradictions through technology and the weakening of liberal institutions, betting on a break with the existing order to give rise to a new hierarchical social and political order.
phrase: I want to accelerate, with technology and markets without a state, the overcoming of liberal institutions, so that a new hierarchical order arises.
eli5: Imagine someone who wants the sandcastle to collapse faster so they can build a new one their way. These people want today's system to break down soon, using technology, so a new, harsher and more hierarchical order can appear.

name: Neoconservatism
description: Right-wing current that unites free markets, traditional values, and an interventionist foreign policy, advocating the promotion of democracy and national interests through military force and global leadership.
phrase: I want to export democracy and defend the nation's interests by military force, uniting free markets with traditional values at home.
eli5: Free markets and traditional values at home, and a strong country that goes abroad to spread democracy, even using the army if needed.

name: Absolute Monarchism
description: Defense of monarchy with unlimited power concentrated in the sovereign, legitimized by tradition or divine right, without a constitution or parliament to restrict the king's authority over state and society.
phrase: I want a unitary realm ruled by a sovereign of divine right, with no parliament or constitution limiting the crown's authority.
eli5: A king or queen rules everything, all alone. No elections, no parliament, no rules to stop them. They say this power came from God or tradition. When they die, their child becomes the new king.

name: Authoritarian Conservatism
description: Current that preserves order, tradition, and hierarchy through a strong state, restricting freedoms and political participation in the name of social stability, morality, religion, and established authority.
phrase: I want a hierarchical order sustained by a strong state, protecting tradition, religion and customs against moral subversion.
eli5: A strong government that wants to keep everything the way it's always been: traditions, order, who gives orders and who obeys. To do that, it may take away some freedoms, like protesting or criticising. The idea is that order and stability matter more than those freedoms.

name: National Conservatism
description: Current that unites traditional values, family, and religion with strong cultural nationalism, defending sovereignty, borders, and the people's identity within democracy, with clear distrust of globalism.
phrase: I want a democracy that protects borders, family and religion, asserting my people's identity against cultural globalism.
eli5: Family, religion and traditions really matter, and the country should make its own decisions without obeying outside organisations. It's looking after your home and your people's culture.

name: Paternalistic Conservatism
description: Conservative tradition that accepts social reforms and protection for the poorest to preserve national cohesion, seeing elites as responsible for the people's welfare and for harmony between classes.
phrase: I want a nation united by responsible elites, who reform and protect the poorest to keep harmony among the classes.
eli5: The well-off and the government should look after the poor, like a parent looks after their children, so the country stays united and peaceful. Change slowly and help those in need.

name: Religious Fundamentalism
description: Project that seeks to organize state and society according to the strict interpretation of a religious doctrine, subordinating laws, customs, and politics to sacred precepts and rejecting modern secularism.
phrase: I want a state subordinated to sacred law, where customs and politics obey religious doctrine and reject secularism.
eli5: It's when a country makes its laws by following a religion's holy book exactly, word for word. Whatever the religion says becomes the law for everyone, even for people who don't believe in it.

name: Ethnic Nationalism
description: Conception that defines the nation by shared origin, language and descent, defending a state for the majority ethnic group and the preservation of its identity, which usually implies membership criteria tied to ancestry.
phrase: I want a state of my ethnic group, united by shared language, origin and descent, that preserves my people's identity and continuity.
eli5: These people think the country belongs only to those with the same origins, the same language and the same ancestors. People whose families came from somewhere else aren't seen as 'really' part of the country, even if they were born there.

name: Cultural Nationalism
description: Nationalism based on shared language, traditions, and heritage rather than race, which values the people's cultural identity and the integration of those who adopt these values, defending the nation's cohesion.
phrase: I want a nation united by shared language, traditions and heritage, open to those who adopt our values, with a protected, coordinated economy.
eli5: Loving your country because of the language, food, festivals and stories everyone shares. What matters is the culture, not skin colour.

name: Neoreaction
description: Current that rejects modern democracy and egalitarianism and proposes replacing them with hierarchical, efficient governments run like companies by a sovereign, combining traditionalism and technology.
phrase: I want a society ruled by a hierarchical sovereign like a CEO, without democracy, uniting tradition and technology in a lean, efficient state.
eli5: These people think democracy doesn't work. They want the country run like a company, with a very powerful boss, like an owner, and anyone who doesn't like it can just go live somewhere else.

name: Cameralism
description: Administrative doctrine of enlightened absolutism that organized the state through a disciplined bureaucracy and centralized finances, promoting industry, population, and revenue as sources of the monarch's power.
phrase: I want a realm served by a disciplined bureaucracy and centralized finances, growing industry, population and revenue for the crown.
eli5: A long time ago, kings in Germany and Austria wanted their kingdoms to run like clockwork. They trained officials to look after the money, farms and factories very carefully. The king was in charge of everything, but he wanted it all to be well managed.

name: Corporatism
description: Model that organizes society into corporations of workers and employers integrated into the state, seeking harmony between classes and directed economic cooperation instead of conflict or free competition.
phrase: I want a society organized into corporations of employers and workers integrated into the state, in directed harmony between the classes.
eli5: Imagine that instead of bosses and workers fighting, they sit at the same table with the government and agree on everything together: wages, prices, rules. Every job has its own group. The idea is that the country works like a body, where each part does its job without fighting.

name: Reactionaryism
description: Stance that rejects modernity and seeks to restore the pre-revolutionary order, defending monarchy, religion, tradition, and hierarchy against Enlightenment rationalism, liberalism, and democracy.
phrase: I want to restore the throne, the altar and the hierarchy that preceded the revolutions, as a counterweight to Enlightenment rationalism and liberal democracy.
eli5: It's wanting to go back in time to before modern things came along. Kings again, the church back in charge, everyone in their place. It's like undoing the changes of the last few centuries.

name: Fourth Political Theory
description: Theory by Aleksandr Dugin that rejects liberalism, communism, and fascism and proposes a multipolar world founded on civilizations, tradition, and collective identity, opposing globalism and Western hegemony.
phrase: I want a multipolar world of civilizations rooted in tradition and collective identity, raised against globalism and Western hegemony.
eli5: A Russian thinker named Dugin said: 'I don't like capitalism, communism or fascism, so I'll invent a fourth thing'. He wants a world split into big civilisations, each with its own traditions, and without the United States bossing everyone around.

name: National Democracy
description: Current that combines popular sovereignty and democratic institutions with strong cultural nationalism, prioritizing the nation's interests and identity over supranational commitments and multiculturalism.
phrase: I want a sovereign nation that freely votes its own laws, but places the people's identity and interests above any supranational commitment.
eli5: The people vote and choose their leaders, but the country should strongly protect its own culture and identity and decide its own future.

name: Bioconservatism
description: Position that opposes genetic manipulation and the technological enhancement of the human body, defending ethical limits on science in the name of dignity, human nature, and prudence toward the future.
phrase: I want a society that draws ethical limits on genetic manipulation and body enhancement, protecting human dignity in the face of science.
eli5: These people think we shouldn't tinker too much with the human body using science, like changing genes or becoming part robot. For them, being human the way we're born is something special that should be protected.

name: Right-Wing Technocracy
description: Model that entrusts the management of the state and the economy to experts and technological efficiency, combining markets, innovation, and technical decisions instead of political deliberation and traditional party competition.
phrase: I want a government handed to experts and technological efficiency, replacing party competition with technical decisions and markets.
eli5: Experts and technology run the government and the economy so everything works well and fast, with free markets, order and less political arguing.

name: Christian Democracy
description: Centrist current that applies Christian values to democratic politics, defending the social market economy, family, solidarity, and the common good as the foundation of free and pluralist institutions.
phrase: I want a pluralist democracy guided by Christian values, with a social market economy that sustains the family and the common good.
eli5: It's doing politics with Christian values, like helping others and caring for families, but with elections and respect for everyone. Businesses are free, but the government helps people in need.

name: Christian Conservatism
description: Current that grounds politics in Christian morality and tradition, defending family, life, and religious values within democracy, with emphasis on preserving the people's customs and cultural heritage.
phrase: I want a society faithful to Christian morals and faith, protecting family, life and inherited customs against the erosion of the times.
eli5: Doing politics by following Christian values: protecting family, life and faith. The laws should respect what the Bible teaches.

name: Republicanism
description: Political tradition that values popular sovereignty, civic virtue, and the rule of law, defending citizens' self-government, the separation of powers, and protection against tyranny and the corruption of power.
phrase: I want a republic of virtuous citizens, with separation of powers and rule of law, vigilant against tyranny and the corruption of power.
eli5: The country doesn't belong to a king: it belongs to all its citizens. People choose who governs, everyone follows the same laws, and everyone should help look after the country.

name: Constitutional Monarchism
description: Defense of monarchy as a symbol of unity and continuity, with the king subject to the constitution and parliament, uniting tradition and institutional stability with representative democracy and the rule of law.
phrase: I want a king subject to the constitution and parliament, a symbol of unity and continuity within a stable representative democracy.
eli5: The country has a king or queen, but they hardly give orders. Decisions are made by a parliament the people elect. The monarch is like a symbol that brings everyone together, like in the United Kingdom.

name: Neoliberalism
description: Current that advocates free markets, deregulation, privatization, and fiscal discipline, reducing the state's economic role and trusting competition and monetary stability as engines of prosperity.
phrase: I want a free, deregulated market, with a lean state, privatizations and fiscal discipline as engines of prosperity and competition.
eli5: The government should get out of the way: sell its companies, cut rules and spend less. That way businesses compete freely and the economy grows.

name: Ordoliberalism
description: German liberal school of Freiburg (Eucken, Rüstow, Müller-Armack) that defends the free market within firm rules guaranteed by the state, against monopolies and central planning, with a Christian ethical basis and social policy, the origin of the social market economy.
phrase: I want a free market disciplined by firm state rules, that prevent monopolies and sustain the social market economy.
eli5: The market is free, like a game, but the government is the referee that makes sure nobody cheats and no company gets so big it ruins the game. It was an idea from Germany.

name: Distributism
description: Doctrine of Christian inspiration that advocates the wide distribution of property and small-scale production, opposing both monopoly capitalism and state socialism in favor of autonomous communities.
phrase: I want communities of small autonomous owners, with widely distributed property, rejecting monopoly capitalism and the socialist state.
eli5: Instead of a few rich people owning almost everything, or the government owning everything, lots of families each own their own little piece: a shop, a farm, a workshop.

name: Technocracy
description: Model of government in which decisions are made by experts and technical, scientific criteria, entrusting engineers, economists, and scientists with the rational and efficient management of the state and the economy.
phrase: I want a society run by experts, with technical decisions replacing political bargaining and a planned economy guided by scientific criteria.
eli5: The people in charge are experts: scientists, engineers and economists. They make decisions by looking at numbers and studies, not by what's popular.

name: Communitarianism
description: Current that values community bonds, traditions, and the common good above individualism, holding that justice and identity arise from life in community and the responsibilities people share.
phrase: I want a society woven from community bonds and shared traditions, with participatory democracy and an economy aimed at the common good.
eli5: What matters most isn't just each person on their own, but the community: neighbours, family, friends. Everyone should look after the common good and respect the group's traditions.

name: Liberalism
description: Political tradition that places individual freedom at the center, defending rights, tolerance, the rule of law, a market economy, and limits on power, with government subject to the consent of citizens.
phrase: I want a tolerant society founded on individual rights, with government limited by the rule of law and a free market economy.
eli5: Every person is free to think, speak and live their own way. The laws apply equally to everyone, and the government can't run your life without a good reason.

name: Classical Liberalism
description: Original branch of liberalism that defends natural rights, property, free markets, and a minimal state, seeing individual freedom and the strict limitation of power as the foundations of a just society.
phrase: I want a society of natural rights and sacred property, with a minimal state and free market as the foundations of a just life.
eli5: Every person is free to think, speak, work and own things. There is a government, but it's small: it just makes sure nobody steals from, hits or cheats anyone else.

name: Libertarianism
description: Philosophy that advocates maximum individual freedom and a state reduced to essential functions, valuing private property, free markets, and personal autonomy while rejecting state coercion over life.
phrase: I want a society of maximum personal autonomy, with the state reduced to essential functions and private property above any coercion.
eli5: You're the boss of your own life. The government should be really tiny and not tell you what you can eat, buy or do, as long as you don't hurt anyone.

name: Green Liberalism
description: Current that unites individual freedom, markets, and democracy with the ecological agenda, defending sustainability, rights, and innovation to reconcile economic prosperity with effective environmental protection.
phrase: I want a society that unites market and democracy with the ecological cause, innovating to reconcile prosperity with environmental sustainability.
eli5: People and businesses are free, but they have to look after the planet. The idea is to use the market and good rules to protect nature without giving up freedom.

name: Social Liberalism
description: Branch that combines individual freedoms with strong state action to guarantee welfare, education, and healthcare, defending equal opportunity and social security within the market economy.
phrase: I want a society of individual freedoms sustained by strong social security, with the state guaranteeing health and education for all.
eli5: You're free to live your own way, but the government helps so everyone gets a similar chance: good schools, doctors and help when they need it.

name: Conservative Liberalism
description: Synthesis that unites free markets and economic freedoms with the appreciation of tradition, order, and institutions, defending prudent change and social stability within the framework of liberal democracy.
phrase: I want a society that unites the free market with tradition and institutions, changing prudently within the frame of liberal democracy.
eli5: Free markets and freedom for people, but also respect for traditions, order and old institutions that help keep the country stable.

name: Geolibertarianism
description: Synthesis of libertarianism and Georgism that combines free markets and individual freedoms with the taxation of land value, seen as a common resource, to fund the minimal state without punishing labor.
phrase: I want full civil liberties and free markets, taxing only land tenure to fund the minimal state.
eli5: Lots of freedom for everyone, with one catch: nobody made the land, so it belongs a little to everybody. Whoever uses land pays a fee for it, and that's pretty much the only tax there is.

name: State Liberalism
description: Liberal current that accepts an active role for the state in the economy and in guaranteeing rights, combining individual freedoms and markets with regulation and public policies aimed at the collective good and equality.
phrase: I want a market society with an active state, regulating the economy and expanding rights to guarantee collective well-being.
eli5: Freedom and rights for people, but with a government that takes an active part in the economy to make sure those rights really work.

name: Environmentalism
description: Movement dedicated to protecting the environment and the sustainable use of resources, advocating policies against pollution and climate change and harmony between human development and ecological balance.
phrase: I want a society that places ecological balance above consumption, with strong state policies against pollution and climate change.
eli5: Looking after the planet: not polluting rivers, protecting forests and animals, and using nature's resources without using them up.

name: Conservatism
description: Political tradition that values order, customs, family, and consolidated institutions, preferring gradual and prudent change over rupture, based on historical experience and skepticism toward utopias.
phrase: I want a society that preserves customs, family and institutions, changing slowly and with skepticism toward utopias and ruptures.
eli5: If something has worked for a long time, we shouldn't throw it away suddenly. Family, customs and traditions matter, and changes should happen slowly and carefully.

name: Progressivism
description: Current that advocates social reforms and the expansion of rights to promote equality and justice, trusting progress, science, and collective action to transform institutions and overcome inequalities.
phrase: I want a multicultural society in constant reform, expanding rights and using the state to overcome inequality through science.
eli5: These people believe society can always get better. They want to change the rules so everyone has the same rights and is treated fairly.

name: Nationalism
description: Ideology that places the nation as the central value, defending its sovereignty, unity, and identity, and prioritizing the interests of the people and the nation-state over external influences and globalism.
phrase: I want a society assimilated into national identity, with strong order and an economy protected from abroad in the name of the people's sovereignty.
eli5: Your country comes first. It should be strong, united, make its own decisions, and look after its own people before anyone else.

name: Civic Nationalism
description: Nationalism based on citizenship and shared values rather than ethnicity, defining the nation by adherence to common laws and institutions, open to all who accept its democratic and civic principles.
phrase: I want a nation defined by citizenship and common laws, not ethnicity, open to whoever accepts our democratic principles.
eli5: Loving your country, but anyone can be part of it, no matter their skin colour or where their family came from. What unites everyone is the laws and values they all share.

name: Indigenism
description: Current that values indigenous peoples and their rights, defending autonomy, territory, culture, and political participation, along with development models and a plurinational state that respect their traditions.
phrase: I want a plurinational society that respects the territory, autonomy and traditions of indigenous peoples, with their full political participation.
eli5: Indigenous peoples, who lived on the land before everyone else arrived, should have their land, culture and language respected, and be able to decide about their own lives.

name: Socialist Conservatism
description: Current that unites a socialist economy with traditional values, defending social protection and a strong state role alongside family, order, and customs, far from the cultural progressivism of liberal lefts.
phrase: I want a strong state that guarantees social protection and public industry, but guards family, order and customs against cultural progressivism.
eli5: Imagine a government that looks after everyone, giving schools, doctors and jobs, but also wants families to be very traditional, people to go to church, and old customs to be respected. It's helping everyone with money while keeping everything the way it always was.

name: Anarchism
description: Philosophy that rejects the state and all coercive authority, defending the free organization of society through voluntary associations, cooperation, and self-management, with freedom and equality as central values.
phrase: I want a stateless society, organized by voluntary associations and mutual aid, where freedom and equality replace all coercive authority.
eli5: Imagine a playground with no grown-ups giving orders. The kids agree on the rules together and help each other because they want to, not because someone makes them. Anarchism thinks a whole country can work like that, with no government and no bosses.

name: Anarcho-Communism
description: Current that unites anarchism and communism, proposing a society without state or private property, with collective production and distribution according to need, based on free association and mutual aid.
phrase: I want to abolish the state and private property, with collective production and distribution by need, sustained by free association and mutual aid.
eli5: No government and no 'this is mine'. All the toys go into one big box, everyone does what they can and takes what they need. People organise in groups and decide everything together.

name: Anarcho-Syndicalism
description: Current that sees revolutionary unions as the basis for overthrowing capitalism through direct action and the general strike, organizing production by the workers themselves in a free, stateless society.
phrase: I want revolutionary unions to overthrow capitalism through direct action and the general strike, with workers controlling production, statelessly.
eli5: Workers band together in big groups called unions. One day they all stop working at the same time, the bosses and the government lose their power, and the workers themselves start running the factories.

name: Syndicalism
description: Movement that places unions and workers' organization at the center of politics, defending collective bargaining, direct action, and labor control over production as the path to working-class emancipation.
phrase: I want unions and collective bargaining at the center of politics, with worker control over production as the path to the working class's emancipation.
eli5: Workers join together in groups called unions to talk to the bosses as a team. That way they're stronger when asking for better pay and conditions.

name: Libertarian Socialism
description: Current that pursues socialism without an authoritarian state, uniting collective ownership and self-management with broad individual freedom, organized from the bottom up by free communities and workers.
phrase: I want socialism without an authoritarian state, with collective property and self-management organized from the bottom up by free communities and workers.
eli5: Sharing things fairly, like in socialism, but without a government in charge. People run their workplaces and neighbourhoods together, and everyone stays free to be who they want.

name: Market Socialism
description: System in which collectively or publicly owned enterprises compete in markets, uniting the efficiency of competition with the socialist distribution of profits, without the rigid central planning of state economies.
phrase: I want collectively owned firms competing in markets, uniting the efficiency of competition with the socialist distribution of profits, without rigid central planning.
eli5: Companies belong to their workers or to the public, but they still compete and sell things like in a normal market. It's competition plus sharing.

name: Mutualism
description: Anarchist current founded by Proudhon that advocates fair exchange, free credit, and use-based property, with producers and cooperatives trading among themselves without exploitation, bosses, or a central state.
phrase: I want cooperatives and producers trading fairly, with free credit and possession by use, free of bosses, exploitation and a central state.
eli5: Imagine swapping stickers fairly: if you worked an hour, you get an hour's worth back. Nobody gets rich just from owning stuff. People lend to each other without interest and work in friendly co-ops.

name: Minarcho-Mutualism
description: Synthesis that unites mutualism with a minimal state, combining fair exchange, cooperatives, and free credit with a public structure reduced to the essential functions of protecting rights, contracts, and freedoms.
phrase: I want mutualism's cooperatives and free credit added to a minimal state, restricted to protecting essential rights, contracts and freedoms.
eli5: A very small government that only handles the basics, and everything else people do in mutual-aid groups, trading work fairly and lending without charging interest.

name: Communalism
description: Model created by Murray Bookchin based on autonomous municipalities and federated popular assemblies, with a community economy and direct democracy, seeking to replace the state with a free confederation.
phrase: I want autonomous municipalities with federated popular assemblies, a community economy and direct democracy, replacing the state with a free confederation.
eli5: Every neighbourhood or town holds a big meeting where everyone votes on decisions. The towns link up like a network of friends, with no big government on top, and they take good care of nature.

name: Christian Socialism
description: Current of Thomas Müntzer, the peasants of 1525 and priests such as Camilo Torres, which seeks the Kingdom of God on Earth through revolution, with common property and power in the hands of the poor.
phrase: I want the Kingdom of God on Earth through the revolution of the poor, with all goods in common and power in the hands of those who work.
eli5: These people read the Bible and believe Jesus wanted the rich to share with the poor. Some really fought to create 'the Kingdom of God on Earth', a world where everything is shared fairly.

name: Christian Labourism
description: Branch that combines the defense of workers and social justice with Christian values, promoting labor rights, solidarity, and social protection within democracy, inspired by the social doctrine of the Church.
phrase: I want labor rights and social protection within democracy, inspired by the Church's social doctrine and Christian solidarity.
eli5: Standing up for workers and social justice because Christian faith teaches us to care for our neighbours and the weakest.

name: Christian Social Democracy
description: Current that turns the Gospel into reforms within democracy, defending a welfare state, labor rights, unions and redistribution without breaking with the market or with liberal institutions.
phrase: I want social justice guided by the Gospel, won at the ballot box, with strong unions, a welfare state and dignity for working people.
eli5: Using the Gospel's teachings to make laws that help people: healthcare, schools, workers' rights, always with democracy and elections.

name: Social Democracy
description: Current that seeks to reconcile capitalism and social justice through democracy, defending regulated markets, a strong welfare state, labor rights, and redistribution to reduce social inequalities.
phrase: I want a society of regulated markets and a strong welfare state, with labor rights and redistribution through democratic means.
eli5: Businesses can exist and make money, but they pay taxes so the government can provide schools, doctors and help for everyone. It's capitalism with a safety net.

name: Socialism
description: Broad doctrine that advocates social or collective ownership of the means of production and economic planning to overcome capitalist exploitation, accepting both the revolutionary and the reformist road to get there.
phrase: I want a society without exploitation, with collective means of production and economic planning replacing the capitalist market.
eli5: The most important things, like factories and land, should belong to everyone, not just a few rich people. The idea is to share what everyone makes more fairly.

name: Liberal Socialism
description: Current that unites socialist goals of equality and social justice with the defense of individual freedoms and democracy, combining strong social protection with pluralism, civil rights, and a mixed economy.
phrase: I want a society that unites socialist equality with full individual freedoms, with democratic pluralism and a mixed economy.
eli5: Wanting equality and fairness, like socialists, but without giving up each person's freedom to think and live their own way.

name: Social Libertarianism
description: Left-libertarian branch that unites broad individual freedom with collective or shared ownership of resources, defending autonomy, cooperation, and the rejection of both the authoritarian state and capital.
phrase: I want autonomous communities of shared property, without state or capital, uniting individual freedom and collective cooperation.
eli5: You're free to live however you like, but the important things, like land and factories, belong to everyone. It's freedom for each person and sharing for the group.

name: Eco-Socialism
description: Current that fuses socialism and ecology, attributing the environmental crisis to capitalism and defending collective, sustainable, and democratic production that respects the limits of nature and social needs.
phrase: I want a society that overcomes capitalism with collective, sustainable production, planned democratically within the limits of nature.
eli5: These people think the planet is being damaged because companies only care about profit. They want the economy to belong to everyone and look after nature.

name: Deep Ecology
description: Current that attributes intrinsic value to all life and not only to human beings, defending a profound change of values, the reduction of human impact, and respect for the balance of the planet's ecosystems.
phrase: I want a society that recognizes intrinsic value in all life, reducing human impact out of respect for the balance of ecosystems.
eli5: Animals, plants and rivers matter just as much as people. We're not the owners of the Earth, just a part of it, and we need to change the way we live a lot.

name: Agrarian Anarchism
description: Anarchist branch centered on the countryside, defending autonomous rural communities, collective ownership of land, and peasant cooperation, rejecting the state and land concentration in favor of self-management.
phrase: I want autonomous rural communities with collective land, without state or large estates, organized by peasant cooperation and self-management.
eli5: It's anarchism in the countryside. Farmers look after the land together, with no landlord and no government, and share what they grow. Each village decides its own business.

name: Green Anarchism
description: Current that unites anarchism and radical ecology, defending decentralized, sustainable communities without a state or exploitation of nature, in harmony with ecological cycles and non-human life.
phrase: I want decentralized communities without a state, living in harmony with ecological cycles, without exploiting nature.
eli5: No government and lots of love for nature. People live in small communities, grow their own food, and try not to harm the planet.

name: Anarcho-Progressivism
description: Synthesis of anarchist currents centered on the liberation of body and identity, uniting the critique of patriarchy and of gender and sexuality norms with an openness to technology as a tool of emancipation, all under the rejection of the state, capitalism, and every imposed hierarchy.
phrase: I want a society without state, capital or hierarchy, freeing body and identity from patriarchy through emancipatory technology.
eli5: Nobody should boss anyone around: not the government, not men over women, not rules about how you should be or who you can love. Every person owns their own body and their own life.

name: Anarcho-Pacifism
description: Anarchist branch that rejects the state and all violence, defending social transformation through nonviolent means, civil disobedience, and voluntary cooperation as the path to a free and just society.
phrase: I want a society without state or violence, built through civil disobedience and voluntary cooperation among free people.
eli5: No government and no violence at all. If something is unfair, you don't hit anyone: you just peacefully refuse to obey until things change.

name: Christian Anarchism
description: Current that unites Christian faith with anarchism, holding that the Gospel preaches love, equality, and nonviolence incompatible with the state, and defending free communities based on conscience and charity.
phrase: I want free communities guided by the Gospel, without a state, living out love and equality through conscience and charity.
eli5: These people read the Bible and believe Jesus taught us to love everyone, share, and never use violence. So they think we don't need government, only love for each other.

name: Anarcho-Naturism
description: Anarchist branch linked to naturism that defends simple living in contact with nature, without a state or oppressive conventions, valuing individual autonomy, health, and harmony with the natural world.
phrase: I want to live without state or oppressive conventions, in simple contact with nature, valuing individual autonomy and health.
eli5: Living simply, close to nature, eating natural food and with no government giving orders. These people think life is healthier and freer that way.

name: Geoanarchism
description: Synthesis of anarchism and Georgism that rejects the state but treats land and natural resources as commons, defending that their rent be shared by the whole community in a free and egalitarian way.
phrase: I want to abolish the state and treat land as a common heritage, sharing its revenues directly among free communes.
eli5: No government, but with one special rule: the land belongs to everyone. Whoever uses a piece of land pays a little to the community, and that money is shared among everyone.

name: Anarcho-Capitalism
description: Current that proposes abolishing the state and organizing all of society through contracts and free markets, with security, justice, and services provided by competing private companies under absolute property rights.
phrase: I want to abolish the state and organize everything through contracts and free markets, with security and justice sold by private companies.
eli5: No government at all. Everything becomes a business: even police and judges would be companies you choose and pay for, like picking a pizza place. Everyone owns their stuff and agrees on everything by contract.

name: Minarchism
description: Libertarian branch that defends a minimal state limited to police, courts, and defense, leaving everything else to the market and private initiative, to protect individual rights without oppressing freedom.
phrase: I want a minimal state, restricted to police, courts and defense, leaving everything else to the free market and private initiative.
eli5: The government is like a night watchman: it only has police, judges and an army to protect people. Everything else, like schools and hospitals, is left to people and businesses.

name: Paleolibertarianism
description: Branch that combines radical free markets with traditional, conservative cultural values, defending economic freedom, property, and autonomous local communities against the state and progressivism.
phrase: I want radical free markets united with traditional values, with property and autonomous local communities against the state.
eli5: Very little government and a free market, but with very traditional values: family, church and community. Free in the economy, old-fashioned in the way of life.

name: Hoppean Libertarianism
description: Current tied to Hans-Hermann Hoppe that joins anarcho-capitalism, absolute private property and criticism of democracy, defending social orders based on contract, voluntary association and private authority.
phrase: I want an order of absolute private property, governed by contracts and by communities that set their own rules, with no democracy and no state.
eli5: A thinker named Hoppe believes even democracy is bad. For him, everything should be private property, with no government, and each community would choose who can come in, like a gated neighbourhood.

name: Capitalism
description: Economic system based on private property, free markets, and the pursuit of profit, in which production and prices are regulated by competition and supply and demand, with individual initiative as its engine.
phrase: I want a society driven by individual initiative, where competition and the free market, not the state, decide prices, production and profit.
eli5: People can own their own shops and factories, sell things and make money. Whoever makes a good, cheap product sells more. Prices are set by buyers and sellers.

name: Objectivism
description: Philosophy created by Ayn Rand that exalts reason, individualism, and rational egoism, defending laissez-faire capitalism and the pursuit of one's own happiness as the supreme moral purpose of each person's life.
phrase: I want a society of rational egoism and reason, where each person pursues their own happiness and laissez-faire capitalism is the only valid morality.
eli5: A writer named Ayn Rand said it's good to look out for yourself and use reason. Each person should chase their own dreams and keep what they earn, and the government shouldn't take it from them.

name: Eco-Capitalism
description: Current that seeks to solve the environmental crisis through the market, using pricing, green technology, and incentives to make protecting nature profitable and compatible with growth and free enterprise.
phrase: I want a green market economy, where pricing, technology and profit make protecting nature compatible with growth and free enterprise.
eli5: Using the market itself to save the planet: polluters pay more, and companies that invent clean technology make money from it.

name: Eco-Conservatism
description: Branch that unites conservatism and environmental protection, defending the preservation of nature as part of the tradition and heritage to be passed on to future generations, with prudence toward change.
phrase: I want to preserve nature as part of the tradition and heritage passed down to us, with prudence toward change and a mixed, balanced economy.
eli5: These people see caring for nature as a tradition, like looking after the family home. They want to protect the country's forests, fields and landscapes as something handed down from grandparents.

name: Eco-Nationalism
description: Current that links environmental protection to national sovereignty, prioritizing the protection of the country's own natural resources and land and sustainable development within national borders.
phrase: I want to protect my nation's natural resources and land, with state planning and economic borders that guarantee sovereignty and sustainability.
eli5: Protecting your own country's nature, its forests, rivers and animals, and not letting other countries or foreign companies decide about it.

name: Crypto-Anarchism
description: Current that uses cryptography and digital technologies to guarantee privacy, freedom, and transactions beyond state control, seeking to weaken surveillance and authority through technological means.
phrase: I want a life protected by cryptography, free of surveillance and borders that block transactions, dissolving the state's authority through technology.
eli5: Using secret computer codes and digital money so the government can't see or control what you do or buy. Your digital life stays just yours.

name: Bleeding-Heart Libertarianism
description: Current that unites free markets and individual freedoms with concern for social justice, holding that economic freedom must also concretely improve the lives of the poorest and most vulnerable.
phrase: I want economic and individual freedom that also lifts the poorest out of misery, uniting the free market with compassion for social justice.
eli5: Free markets and little government, yes, but with a focus on the poor: these people think freedom should also help poor people have a good life.

name: National Libertarianism
description: Branch that combines the defense of individual freedoms and free markets with appreciation for national sovereignty and identity, defending limited government alongside border control and the nation.
phrase: I want limited government and free markets that also protect borders, sovereignty and my nation's identity.
eli5: Lots of freedom for people and businesses, but with pride in your own country and well-guarded borders. Free on the inside, firm on the outside.

name: Libertarian Monarchism
description: Current that sees monarchy as a guarantee of freedom and stability, defending a king with limited power who protects property and individual rights and maintains a lean, minimally interventionist state.
phrase: I want a king of limited power who guarantees property and individual rights, keeping the state lean and out of people's lives.
eli5: Having a king or queen, but one who doesn't boss people around much. The king acts like a guardian protecting people's freedom and property, instead of politicians who keep changing.

name: Federalist Monarchism
description: Current advocating a monarch who actually governs, as constitutional head of the executive or absolute sovereign, over a federation of states or regions with broad self-government, as in the German Empire of 1871, the United Arab Emirates, and Malaysia.
phrase: I want a monarch who truly governs a federation of states with their own laws, dynasties, and self-rule, united by the crown and the faith.
eli5: A king who really governs, but over a country made of several states that handle many things themselves, like the United Arab Emirates or old Germany.

name: Libertarian Conservatism
description: Synthesis that unites free markets and a minimal state with the defense of tradition, family, and order, valuing individual freedom and personal responsibility alongside the preservation of customs and institutions.
phrase: I want economic freedom and a minimal state alongside the tradition, family and customs that sustain the social order.
eli5: Small government and free markets, with respect for traditions, family and order. People should be free, but without throwing away old customs.

name: Progressive Libertarianism
description: Branch that pursues gender equality through individual freedom and the market rather than the state, defending autonomy, equal rights, and the end of legal restrictions on women's choices.
phrase: I want women to win equality through individual freedom and the market, without state guardianship over their bodies and choices.
eli5: Men and women should have the same chances, but that should come from each person's freedom and from the market, not from a big government making lots of rules.

name: Anarcho-Conservatism
description: Current that rejects the state but preserves tradition, religion, and community values, defending a spontaneous social order based on customs, family, and natural authority instead of central political power.
phrase: I want to abolish central political power and live under custom, family and natural authority, in a spontaneous order that preserves tradition and faith.
eli5: No government, but lots of tradition. People organise through family, religion and community, like an old village where everyone follows the customs without needing state police.

name: Anarcho-Distributism
description: Synthesis of anarchism and distributism that defends the wide distribution of property and small-scale production, with autonomous communities and cooperatives organized without a state or large monopolies.
phrase: I want property widely distributed among cooperatives and autonomous communities, producing on a small scale without state or monopolies.
eli5: Instead of a few people owning almost everything, every family has its own little shop, farm or workshop. No government, and everyone owns a little bit.

name: Centrism
description: Political position that seeks balance between left and right, valuing moderation, pragmatism, and consensus, and combining elements of different currents to avoid extremes and favor gradual reforms.
phrase: I want moderation and pragmatism between left and right, combining the best of each current in gradual reforms that avoid extremes.
eli5: Not too far one way, not too far the other. Take the good ideas from the left and the right and look for a middle path that keeps most people happy.

name: Labourism
description: Current that defends workers' interests within democracy, promoting labor rights, social security, strong unions, and income distribution through reforms and the welfare state.
phrase: I want a society where strong unions and the welfare state guarantee labor rights and income distributed through democracy.
eli5: Standing up for workers within democracy: good wages, pensions, workplace rights and strong unions.

name: Positivism
description: Current inspired by Auguste Comte that trusts science and reason to organize society, defending order, progress, and technical administration guided by knowledge in place of metaphysics and tradition.
phrase: I want a society ruled by order and progress, run by technicians who replace tradition and metaphysics with science.
eli5: A man named Comte thought science could solve everything, even how to run a country. He believed very learned people should organise society like scientists in a lab. The motto 'Order and Progress' on Brazil's flag came from this idea.

name: Secular Conservatism
description: Conservative branch that defends order, tradition, and institutions without grounding them in religion, supporting cultural values and social stability with secular, historical, and pragmatic arguments.
phrase: I want a society that preserves tradition and institutions through secular, historical arguments, without appealing to religion for it.
eli5: Valuing order, traditions and institutions, but without using religion as the reason. It's being conservative without needing to go to church.

name: Christian Progressivism
description: Current that unites Christian faith with the defense of social justice, rights, and reforms, seeing in the Gospel a call to solidarity, equality, and care for the poor and marginalized of society and the world.
phrase: I want a society guided by the Gospel as a call to social justice, solidarity and care for the poor.
eli5: These people believe Jesus's message is about helping the poor and treating everyone fairly, so they support social change and more rights for all.

name: Modernizing Authoritarianism
description: Model inspired by Park Chung-hee's regime, combining state-led industrialization, credit for private firms, and planning with anti-communist political repression.
phrase: I want a developmental state directing credit and private industry, imposing political order in the name of national progress.
eli5: A strong government without much democracy, like South Korea under Park Chung-hee, that pushes the country to build factories and grow fast to escape poverty.

name: State Developmentalism
description: Model in which the state directs industrialization and economic growth through planning, public investment, and industrial protection, seeking to overcome the nation's backwardness and external dependence.
phrase: I want a state that drives industrialization through plans and public investment, protecting industry against external dependence.
eli5: The government drives the country's growth: it plans, builds factories and roads, and sets up its own companies to make the country rich and modern.

name: Atlanticism
description: Geopolitical doctrine of the alliance between the US, Canada and Europe around NATO and the EU, which backs the alliance's eastward expansion and the use of Western military power to spread liberal democracy and free markets against Russia and China.
phrase: I want the West united in NATO and the EU, expanding the alliance and using military might to spread liberal democracy and free markets.
eli5: The United States, Canada and Europe are like one big team of friends who protect each other through NATO and stand up for democracy and free trade.

name: Techno-Monarchism
description: A unitary variant of neoreaction: an absolute CEO-monarch rules a centralized state through data and security technology (surveillance, AI), under market capitalism, private property and free enterprise, for the sake of stability and efficiency.
phrase: I want an absolute monarch with a CEO mindset ruling a unitary state through data and security technology while leaving the market free.
eli5: Imagine the country has a king, but he's like the boss of a big tech company. He uses cameras, data and artificial intelligence to run everything, and nobody votes.

name: Right-Wing Progressivism
description: Right-wing progressive branch that unites capitalism and the cult of technological progress with a socially progressive, pragmatic, and secular culture, entrusting society's direction to a technical elite rather than mass democracy.
phrase: I want a secular, progressive society driven by the cult of technological progress, guided by a technical elite above mass democracy.
eli5: Really liking capitalism and technology, and also being modern about lifestyles, with no religion in charge. But experts steer the country more than the people's vote does.

name: Techno-Socialism
description: Current that joins the dictatorship of the proletariat with technological accelerationism, defending a revolutionary party, data-driven planning, automation, and collective ownership to lead the transition to communism.
phrase: I want a society under the dictatorship of the proletariat, with algorithmic planning, automation, and collective ownership advancing toward communism.
eli5: A revolutionary party that runs everything and uses robots, computers and artificial intelligence to plan the economy and end poverty as fast as possible.

name: Techno-Fascism
description: Current that joins the totalitarian authoritarianism of fascism to digital surveillance, artificial intelligence and technological control of the population, using technique to secure order and national unity.
phrase: I want a strong, totalitarian state that uses digital surveillance and artificial intelligence to secure the order and unity of the nation.
eli5: It's fascism with computers. A government that controls everything uses cameras, phones and artificial intelligence to watch everyone all the time. Nobody can disagree, because the machines always find out.

name: Authoritarian Liberalism
description: Current that combines a market economy, private property, trade openness, and technocracy with low democratic participation, holding that a strong, efficient state should preserve order, stability, and growth.
phrase: I want a market and technocratic economy, with low democratic participation, under a strong state that guarantees order and growth.
eli5: People can trade and own businesses freely, but the government is strong and doesn't let ordinary people take much part in decisions. The idea is that experts should rule well and quickly, without a lot of voting getting in the way.

name: Progressive Nationalism
description: Current that unites national sovereignty, economic protection, and popular integration with progressive social reforms, seeking a state capable of defending the nation while expanding rights, equality, and inclusion.
phrase: I want a sovereign, economically protected nation that expands rights and equality through progressive social reforms.
eli5: Loving and protecting your own country and its economy, while also standing up for equal rights and including everyone, leaving nobody behind.

name: Eco-Fascism
description: Current that joins radical ecology, authoritarianism and white nationalism, associated with Mike Ma and the Pine Tree Party: it defends industrial collapse, population control and nature preservation imposed by an authoritarian order.
phrase: I want an organic national community in harmony with the land, putting environmental preservation and the survival of the people above individual liberties.
eli5: These people want to protect nature with a very strict government that nobody can vote out. They believe there are too many people on the planet and that only their own group should stay. They want factories shut down and fewer people on Earth.

name: Agrarian Communism
description: Revolutionary model that idealizes peasant life and collective rural production, rejecting cities, markets, and private property in favor of an equality imposed by state mobilization and communal discipline.
phrase: I want a collectivized peasant life, without cities or markets, with equality imposed by state mobilization and communal discipline.
eli5: These people think country life is the best life. They want everyone to work together on farms, with no cities, no shops and nobody owning the land.

name: Bolivarian Socialism
description: Latin American project that combines popular nationalism, anti-imperialism, social redistribution, and strong presidential leadership, using the state and strategic resources to promote sovereignty and popular inclusion.
phrase: I want a sovereign homeland under strong presidential leadership, using nationalized strategic resources for redistribution and popular inclusion.
eli5: It's Hugo Chávez's idea in Venezuela. The government uses oil money to help the poor and stands up to the United States, but power became more and more concentrated in the leader.

name: National Developmentalism
description: Current that advocates industrialization, national sovereignty, and strategic state planning, seeking to modernize the economy through public investment, productive protection, and coordination between government, science, and national companies.
phrase: I want a nation industrialized by strong state planning, protecting national companies and coordinating government, science and industry.
eli5: The country should build its own factories and industries, with the government planning, so it doesn't depend on other countries and becomes strong and modern.

name: Libertarian Populism
description: Branch that unites anti-politics, radical free markets, and direct popular communication, attacking bureaucracies, taxes, and party elites in the name of individual freedom, entrepreneurship, and the sovereignty of the ordinary citizen.
phrase: I want a society free of bureaucracy and taxes, where the ordinary citizen builds a business without party elites ruling their life.
eli5: A leader who shouts 'enough politicians, enough taxes!' and talks straight to the people on social media. He wants to cut the government down and set the market free.

name: Christian Theocratism
description: Christian theocratist doctrine that subordinates political power to religious authority, holding that divine law and the Church should govern the state and customs, from medieval and papal ultramontanism to modern reconstructionist projects.
phrase: I want a society ruled by divine law, with the Church above the state and customs subordinated to religious authority.
eli5: It's a country where the rules come from the Bible and the church helps run things. The laws follow what Christian leaders say God wants, for everyone.

name: Titoist Socialism
description: Variant of socialism developed in Tito's Yugoslavia, combining single-party rule and a cult of the leader with workers' self-management of enterprises, federal decentralization, market openness, and non-alignment between the Cold War blocs.
phrase: I want a federation of soviets self-managed by workers, with a single party, non-alignment and controlled openness to the market.
eli5: In Yugoslavia, Tito made a different kind of communism: workers helped run the factories, and the country didn't obey the Soviet Union. But there was only one party, and everyone had to like Tito.

name: Anti-Colonial Socialism
description: Socialist current born of national liberation struggles in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, defending economic sovereignty, resource nationalization, non-alignment, and solidarity among peoples of the Global South against imperialism.
phrase: I want a people freed from imperialism, with nationalized resources and solidarity among the nations of the Global South.
eli5: When countries in Africa, Asia and Latin America broke free from those who ruled them, many wanted to use socialism to share wealth and stop depending on rich countries.

name: Techno-Communism
description: Current that combines the final stage of communism with technological acceleration, using automation and AI to overcome scarcity, necessary labor, and private property.
phrase: I want a classless society of abundance, where automation and AI overcome scarcity, necessary labour, and private property.
eli5: Imagine robots doing almost all the work and computers organising everything. Since the machines make everything, nobody needs money any more: everyone takes what they need.

name: Techno-Anarchism
description: Technological anarchism that proposes abolishing the state through automation, abundant energy, decentralized networks, and self-managed voluntary communities with digital tools and free local production.
phrase: I want self-managed, stateless communities, freed by automation and abundant energy, producing locally in free networks.
eli5: With the internet, cheap energy and machines doing the work, people wouldn't need a government any more. Each community runs itself using technology.

name: Christian Accelerationism
description: Current that fuses traditional Christianity with technological acceleration, holding that artificial intelligence, industry and national power should be driven forward unchecked as a civilisational mission against secular decay.
phrase: I want to accelerate technology and national power under traditional Christian values, with no progressive brakes or secular decay.
eli5: These people are traditional Christians, but they want to speed up technology, artificial intelligence and industry as much as possible, as a mission to make their country and faith strong.

name: Right-Wing Populism
description: Current that mobilizes the people against political and cultural elites, combining nationalism, immigration restriction, traditional values, public religion, strong security, and anti-establishment economic pragmatism around personalist leaders.
phrase: I want a people united against elites distant from them, with controlled borders, traditional values and a leader who restores order.
eli5: A leader says: 'ordinary people on one side, the powerful elites and politicians on the other'. He promises to protect the country, control immigration and defend traditional ways.

name: Left-Wing Populism
description: Current that mobilizes the people against economic elites, defending redistribution, public control, national sovereignty, plebiscitary democracy, and broad social policy in popular anti-establishment language.
phrase: I want the people mobilized against economic elites, with popular plebiscites and the state redistributing wealth to those below.
eli5: A leader says: 'working people on one side, the super-rich and bankers on the other'. He promises to take from the rich and give to the people.

name: Social Centrism
description: Centrist branch that accepts the market economy but prioritizes social protection, public services, gradual reforms, and institutional consensus to reduce inequality without political rupture or permanent polarization.
phrase: I want a market balanced by strong social protection, with gradual reforms and institutional consensus reducing inequality.
eli5: Let businesses run, but make sure everyone has schools, doctors and help when they need it. Change things slowly, without big shocks.

name: Liberal Centrism
description: Pro-market centrist branch that combines fiscal responsibility, liberal democracy, moderate international openness, and institutional reform, rejecting both broad statism and libertarian radicalism as a political program.
phrase: I want a fiscally responsible liberal democracy, open to the world, far from heavy statism and libertarian radicalism.
eli5: Free markets, tidy government finances and a democracy that works well. It's the middle of the road, leaning a bit towards economic freedom.

name: Green Centrism
description: Centrist branch that prioritizes sustainability, gradual energy transition, environmental regulation, and technological prudence, seeking to reconcile climate protection, markets, and democratic institutions without anti-capitalist rupture.
