description: Authoritarian, corporatist, Catholic regime of Dollfuss and Schuschnigg (1934–1938): single party (Fatherland Front), a Ständestaat inspired by Quadragesimo Anno, repression of socialists and Nazis, and defense of a German, Christian, independent Austria.
phrase: I want a Christian, independent Austria under a strong chancellor and a single party, with Catholic corporations replacing parliament, parties and unions.
eli5: In Austria, before Hitler arrived, a very Catholic government got rid of the parties and kept only one. It organised society by jobs and controlled everything, but it was against the Nazis.

name: Enlightenment
description: Eighteenth-century European intellectual movement that champions reason, science and tolerance against superstition and absolutism, with natural rights, separation of powers, education and progress as the basis of society.
phrase: I want a society guided by reason, science and tolerance, with natural rights, separated powers and the law placed above throne and altar.
eli5: About 300 years ago, thinkers said: 'let's use reason and science instead of just following what we've always been told'. They stood for freedom, tolerance and people's rights.

name: Social Ecology
description: Current founded by Murray Bookchin that explains the ecological crisis through social domination and proposes autonomous municipalities, direct democracy, and a cooperative economy in confederations, influencing Rojava's democratic confederalism.
phrase: I want a society of autonomous municipalities and direct assemblies that overcomes hierarchy and organizes the economy in cooperatives and ecological confederations.
eli5: Bookchin said people damage nature because they also boss each other around. If communities decide everything together without bosses, they'll also look after the planet better.

name: Ligma Feudalism
description: A political system in which sigma males replace the hereditary aristocracy. Social hierarchy is determined exclusively by sigma mindset, physical performance, and emotional resilience. The Sigma Lord governs without a state — natural dominance is the only law.
phrase: I want a society where sigmas rule, betas obey, and the state is replaced by the natural hierarchy of sigma mindset.
eli5: It's a joke ideology from the internet. Instead of kings and nobles, the bosses are the 'sigmas': the strongest, most focused, most 'lone wolf' guys. The more gym and 'sigma mindset' you have, the higher you climb in the castle.

name: Vibe Communism
description: A political system in which the means of production are collectively owned, but the state's only obligation is to ensure everyone can vibe without disturbance. Foreign policy is defined by the vibe — wars are banned for being anti-vibe.
phrase: I want a society where collective ownership exists so that everyone can be unbothered and the vibes flow freely to all.
eli5: It's a joke ideology. Everything belongs to everyone, and the government's only job is to let people enjoy the vibes in peace. Wars are banned because they ruin the vibe.

name: Corpianism
description: A political system in which corporations are recognised as full citizens. Over time, corporations vote, elect other corporations, and eventually a corporation becomes president. The state is a subsidiary of the market.
phrase: I want a society where corporations are people, the market is the government, and the CEO-President leads the nation with spreadsheet efficiency.
eli5: It's a joke ideology. Companies become real citizens: they vote, elect other companies, and in the end a company becomes president. The country becomes just a small part of the market.

name: Chronocracy
description: A political system in which power is exercised exclusively by the eldest. The more years one has lived, the more votes one holds. The Council of Elders governs with accumulated wisdom and deep suspicion of anything invented after 1987.
phrase: I want a society governed by the eldest, where experience is the only criterion for power and the young learn to be quiet and wait their turn.
eli5: Imagine that the older you are, the more votes you get. Your grandpa votes lots of times, your dad a bit less, and you hardly at all. A council of grandmas and grandpas decides everything, because they've lived the longest.

name: Lore Goblinism
description: A political system in which scribes, lorekeepers, and guardians of ancient knowledge constitute the ruling class. Industry is banned for corrupting the lore. Wealth is measured in tomes. The Grand Lorekeeper holds supreme power.
phrase: I want a society governed by the guardians of lore, where ancient knowledge is sacred, industry is heresy, and every library is a temple.
eli5: It's a joke ideology. The rulers are the keepers of old stories, who know all the secrets and legends. Factories are banned because they spoil the stories. Whoever knows the most 'lore' is the most in charge.

name: DB-Fascism
description: Railway fascism of DB-Staat: the Fahrplan is the constitution, citizenship is restricted to Familienangehörige and the trains are still late. The state officially acknowledges that delays are inevitable but promises the next departure will be on time.
phrase: I want a state governed by the Fahrplan, where punctuality is the law, trains arrive when they arrive, and Dennis Becker assures you the next one is definitely coming.
eli5: It's a joke ideology about Germany's train company. The train timetable is the most important law in the land, everyone obeys the train... and the trains are still late.

name: Hatred
description: The ideology of absolute refusal: it proposes no programme, order, or future, only the negation of every question and every political promise. Its only consensus is saying no to everything, and its only project is contempt.
phrase: I want a society that says no to every question, where total refusal is the only programme and contempt is the only politics.
eli5: This ideology doesn't want to build anything. It just says 'no' to everything and everyone. No plan, no promises, only rejection of everything. It's like a kid who says no to every game.

name: Deltocracy
description: A system in which citizenship is measured in inches of deltoid and points of IQ. Sovereign gym-cities compete in a totally free market, steroids and gene editing are a sacred right, only the enhanced may vote and the Supreme Deltoid rules forever. Meow.
phrase: I want sovereign gym-cities in a limitless market, where steroids and edited genes are sacred and only those with delts and IQ vote.
eli5: It's a joke ideology. The bigger your shoulder muscles and the smarter you are, the more say you get. Cities are gyms that compete with each other, and everything is free-market. Meow.
